title: Regularisation: L1 and L2, dropout, data augmentation and hyperparameter search
summary: L1 and L2 penalties as shrinkage and their effect on the optimisation problem; dropout and its implementation caveats; data augmentation; stochastic gradient descent and the learning rate as regularisers; hyperparameter tuning and its perils.
